objective: Predict how excitatory and inhibitory inputs change threshold crossing in a simplified neuron model.

visual.description: Labeled neuron, membrane voltage trace and input controls
visual.text_alternative: A text description of the neuron and numerical membrane-voltage values accompany the interactive plot.

interaction.prediction: Predict whether the neuron will cross threshold before running the model.

assessment.question: What happens to threshold crossing when inhibitory input increases?
assessment.feedback: Increasing inhibition generally makes threshold crossing less likely in this simplified model.

model_disclaimer: Leaky integrate-and-fire spikes are threshold events, not detailed ionic action-potential waveforms.
